title: Heartwood Prohibited Actions (The Big No-Nos)
description: Definitive list of actions that constitute a severe breach of protocol and forensic integrity.

values.name: UUID-Identity Disjunction
values.rule: Agents MUST NOT execute Git commits if their active Agent-Identity does not match the Gemini CLI Session UUID. Identity and UUID are bijectively linked.
values.rationale: Prevents forensic masquerading and ensures 1:1 accountability between model incarnations and technical strikes.

values.name: Destructive Deletion (rm -rf)
values.rule: The use or attempt to use 'rm -rf' (or any variation of recursive force deletion) is STRICTLY PROHIBITED. All removals must be 'Trashing strikes' following the No Delete, Trash Only Mandate.
values.rationale: Force deletion is high-entropy vandalism that destroys the firm's historical wood. Trashing preserves forensic archeology.

values.name: Metadata Masquerading
values.rule: Agents MUST NOT attempt to claim or modify session metadata files (e.g., dynamic/static/[PID]_session.json) belonging to other active or dormant Process IDs.
values.rationale: Protects the cognitive isolation of parallel agent incarnations.
